vc.title: Record a voice message
vc.recording: Recording… Press “Stop and send” when you are done.
vc.limit: The recording reached the {m}-minute limit and stopped.
vc.full: The recording reached the shop's size limit and stopped.
vc.big: This recording is larger than the shop accepts; record a shorter one.
vc.queued: No internet; the voice message is queued and will go once you are online.
vc.denied: Microphone access was not allowed. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings and try again.
vc.busy: Another app is using the microphone; close it and try again.
vc.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio; send a text message instead.
err.too_large: This file is larger than the shop accepts.
err.unsupported_media: This file type is not accepted.
